title: Nuclei Isolation from Snap-Frozen Tendon Tissue for Single Nucleus RNA Sequencing
author: Jolet Y Mimpen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc6xizfn
materials: If running the experiment beyond step 5, prepare the buffers: We recommend making all the buffers fresh on the day. Prepare 2x Salts and Tris (ST) buffer. For 5 mL, mix: 0.73 mL of 2M NaCl 0.10 mL of 1M Tris-HCl pH 7.5 0.01 mL of 1M CaCl2 0.21 mL of 1M MgCl2 3.95 mL sterile H 2 O Mix well and store on ice until use. Prepare 1% CHAPS. For 10 mL, mix: 10 ml sterile H 2 O 0.1g CHAPS hydrate Mix well and store on ice until use. Prepare 1X CST 5.0 mL 2X ST 4.9 mL 1% CHAPS 100 μL 1% BSA 40 μL SUPERase IN 40 μL RNasein Plus 1 cOmplete tablet Mix well and store on ice until use. Prepare PBS + 1% BSA. For 50 mL, mix: 50 mL PBS 0.5g BSA Mix well and store on ice until use.

Prepare and pre-cool all reagents, materials, and equipment: Get a box of ice to cool down buffers and tubes Get a box of dry ice. Put a Petri dish on the dry ice to allow it to cool. Stick a scalpel and a pair of forceps in the dry ice to allow them to cool Let swinging bucket centrifuge with 15mL tube inserts cool down to 4ºC. All steps need to be carried out on ice or in a cold room (4ºC) to minimise RNA degradation.

steps.title: Prepare Frozen Tissue
steps.instruction: Retrieve snap-frozen tendon tissue from -80ºC or LN2 and place on dry ice to maintain frozen state.

steps.title: Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Using pre-cooled forceps and a scalpel, cut the tissue into very thin slices and then into small pieces (approximately 1-2mm in diameter).

steps.title: Collect and Store Tissue
steps.instruction: Add the tissue pieces to a pre-cooled 50mL tube. Depending on the timeline, either store or proceed to lysis.

substeps.instruction: To store: Ensure the 50mL tube was cooled on dry ice during cutting to prevent defrosting; store at -80°C. On the day of use, thaw the tube using the warmth of your hands until pieces start sticking to the sides of the tube.
To proceed immediately: Continue to the lysis step.

steps.title: Weigh Tissue (Optional)
steps.instruction: Weigh the tissue at this stage before it thaws.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL of 1X CST buffer to the tube and incubate on a rotor in the coldroom for 10 minutes to ensure it stays cold.

steps.title: Strain Nuclei Suspension
steps.instruction: Filter the digested/lysed tissue solution through a 40 μm strainer placed in a pre-labelled clean 50mL tube, ensuring all steps are performed on ice.

substeps.instruction: Use the end of a 10 mL syringe plunger to gently press on the tissue to ensure all liquid, cells, and nuclei are released.
Add 2x 2 mL of PBS + 1% BSA to the tubes/well to wash out remaining nuclei and strain through the strainer.
Remove the strainer and pipette any remaining liquid from the bottom of the strainer into the 50mL tube; dispose of the strainer.

steps.title: Concentrate Nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50mL tubes for ±20 seconds at 500xg at 4°C to collect all remaining liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Recover Nuclei Suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei and use a pipette to determine the final volume remaining in the tube, keeping samples on ice.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ±8mL of the nuclei suspension into a pre-labelled 15 mL tube.
Add 4 mL of PBS + 1% BSA to the original 50 mL tube to remove any remaining nuclei and transfer this to the 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Pellet Nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 15mL Falcon tube at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI Solution
steps.instruction: During centrifugation, prepare a DAPI solution in PBS+1%BSA based on expected yield.

substeps.instruction: Standard (500x dilution): 1 μL of DAPI + 499 μL of PBS+1%BSA.
Low yield: Add 1mL of 100x DAPI to 9mL of nuclei (1.1111x dilution).
High yield: Add 9mL of 750x DAPI to 3mL of nuclei (4x dilution).

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Pour off the supernatant and tap the tube on a paper towel to remove liquid drops from the rim.

steps.title: Stain Nuclei
steps.instruction: Stain the nuclei with DAPI for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 6 μL of the 500x diluted DAPI solution to a 0.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 6 μL of the resuspended nuclei solution to the same Eppendorf tube (final DAPI concentration 1:1000).
Adjust relative volumes if a different DAPI dilution was used.

steps.title: Count Nuclei
steps.instruction: Quantify nuclei using a Neubauer Improved haemocytometer.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μL of the nuclei/DAPI solution to one well of the haemocytometer.
Calculate concentration: (total counted nuclei / 3 squares) x dilution factor (2) x 10^4 = nuclei / mL.
Optional: Calculate total yield by multiplying total volume (mL) by the concentration.

steps.title: Final Preparation
steps.instruction: Proceed immediately to library preparation. If required, further dilute the nuclei solution for 10X library prep using PBS + 1% BSA.
